📜 Update Log

October 23, 2026
  • Developer Mode is back as its own mode: flip the 🛠 Developer Mode switch in Test Mode, confirm, and the game restarts into a normal game with no cheats but with the time controls (speed, pause, step, rewind). It saves on this device again with Continue Battle / New Battle
  • Tips are gone. The Tips button and screen were removed from the game
  • NEW: Settings, Inbox and Chat moved into the account menu. They are buttons along the top of your account screen now, and Back returns you there. The main menu is cleaner
  • NEW: 18 more achievements, from easy ones to some unique ones (check the 🏆 Achievements tab in your account). They are listed in All You Need to Know
  • NEW: a ← BACK button now stays in the top-left corner of the Profile/Login, Inbox, Chat, Updates, Credits and Settings screens, so you no longer have to scroll to the bottom to leave. The Back button at the bottom still works
  • NEW: Teacher Buffs! One permanent buff for each teacher, bought once in the main menu Shop → Upgrades → Teachers for 1000 💚 Positives each (they cost a lot). They are saved on your account and work in every battle while you are signed in
  • 📜 Long Shebab (Wise Sheikh): his throws are Arabic sentences instead of one letter, and each one keeps damaging the kebab for 3 more seconds after it hits
  • 🔥 Long BOYS! (Angry Teacher): her BOYS! ultimate lasts 1.5x longer (3 seconds instead of 2)
  • 🎯 Area Strike (Mathematician): replaces Algebra Swarm. It locks onto 3 kebabs, scans their area with a ring, then strikes for 30% of their health (it is still a 50/50 with Beam Pull)
  • All You Need to Know: the three teacher pages, Ultimates, All Teachers at a Glance and the Shop pages now cover the buffs
  • NEW: 🎁 Daily Rewards! Signed-in players can claim free 💚 Positives once a day from the new 🎁 Daily button at the top right of the main menu (a red ! shows when your reward is ready)
  • Come back every day to build a streak: Day 1 gives 10, then 15, 20, 25, 30, 40 and 75 on Day 7, then it starts again. Missing a day starts the streak over
  • Your daily streak is saved on your account and syncs to the cloud. All You Need to Know: new Daily Rewards page, and the Shop, Accounts and Main Menu pages updated
October 21, 2026
  • NEW: Disclaimers. A pop-up shows the first time you open the game: #1 Early Access (the game isn't released yet, so you might hit bugs or unbalanced things, from Admin Jaiden) and #2 Made with AI (it is a vibe coded game). You can read them again any time with the new ⚠️ Disclaimers link at the bottom of the main menu
  • NEW: accounts made from now on get a gold EARLY ACCESS badge next to their name (in the profile and on the account button). It is saved with the account, including to the cloud for Google-linked accounts
  • All You Need to Know: new Early Access & Disclaimers page, and the Main Menu and Accounts pages updated
October 20, 2026
  • NEW app logo: the Wise Sheikh and the big pink UDR on the green field, with the JH corner ribbon. It is used for the desktop app, the install-to-home-screen icon and the browser tab icon (the tab icon is now built into the game file, so it changes as soon as you upload the new HTML)
October 20, 2026
  • REMOVED the wave-clear coin bonus. Coins now only come from kebabs you defeat (15 each, 60 for a boss). Merged waves no longer pay extra either, and the "coins wave bonus" message is gone
  • All You Need to Know: the Coins, Skip Wave and tips pages no longer mention the bonus
  • FIXED: Wise Sheikh's ultimate sometimes not firing when you clicked him. The whole glowing ring now counts as the click area (before, only the middle did), a neighbouring teacher can no longer steal the click, and it works even if you still have a teacher selected to place
  • After Wise Sheikh uses SHEBAB he is out of breath and cannot attack for 5 seconds
  • Angry Teacher's Negative now does 2x damage (was 3x), everywhere: the game, the shop, tips and the guide (Mathematician's Algebra Swarm on a marked kebab is now 70% instead of 105%)
  • The School Grounds track is now lined up with the squares: the vertical parts used to sit on the lines between squares, now every track fills whole squares
  • The Quad is locked in Test Mode too, until your account reaches level 25
October 20, 2026
  • NEW look for the OZ Tag Kebab: all the old stripes, the headband and the belt are gone. It now has just two random-coloured ribbons on its lower body, blown backwards by the wind (the opposite way to where it is running)
  • The Soccer Kebab's ball is now the last piece of meat on the stick, not on top of it
  • The Quad is darker (an evening pitch) and has a grandstand full of fans along the top of the map, partly cut off by the edge of the screen
  • NEW: a wind whoosh sound plays when menu screens zoom out and switch
  • NEW: a shop theme song plays while either shop is open (the in-game shop and the menu Shop), with a new Shop music setting. The Button click sounds setting is now called Button & menu sounds
  • FIXED: if you continued a saved battle and then lost, the old save was still offered next time. A lost battle now clears its save, so Play starts fresh
  • All You Need to Know: updated the kebab page and the settings list
October 20, 2026
  • NEW: Forgot password. On the Log In screen, press Forgot your password?, verify with Google, and pick a new game password. It works for any account linked to Google, even on a new device
  • NEW: Game password for Google accounts. Accounts made with or linked to Google can set (or change) a game password from the Profile, so you can also log in with your username and password on that device
  • The Sign in with Google button on the Log In screen is now bigger and says no password is needed
  • Logging in with a Google-made account that has no game password now tells you what to do instead of just saying "incorrect password"
  • All You Need to Know: the Accounts page now explains forgot password, game passwords and what happens if the account was never linked
October 19, 2026
  • Fancy Suit is now in the shop (250 💚 per teacher) instead of the Dice achievements, which were removed. Sporty is still 150 💚
  • Improved the Fuming skin: layered red, orange and yellow flames, rising embers, a hot red face and angry eyebrows
  • The old plain black screens (Profile, Login, Inbox, Chat, Tips, Update Log, Credits, Settings) now have animated patterned backgrounds and glass cards that follow your theme

  • NEW: button click sounds, with a new Button click sounds setting

  • NEW: The Quad, a soccer field where kebabs run along the painted lines and gain 35 HP per wave. Choose a free Mathematician or Angry Teacher before you start. Lines unlock at the same waves as the split and tri-track
  • NEW kebabs on the Quad: the Soccer Kebab (wave 5, dodges for 2 seconds with a 5 second cooldown) and the OZ Tag Kebab (wave 10, 50% faster)
  • NEW: Profile customization. Buy accessories (hats, glasses, neck items) and profile backgrounds in the menu Shop under the new Style tab, then wear them from your profile
  • The Shop, Inbox and Chat buttons now show a 🔒 when signed out and ask you to sign in; the main menu and game over screen also invite you to sign up
  • New setting: Level-up pop-ups. Guide: new pages for Levels, Maps, the new kebabs and Profile
October 18, 2026
  • Mathematician now has a short bumpy beard (it also shows in the main menu scene)
  • NEW: Achievements and Skins! 22 achievements (20 give Positives, 2 give skins), claimable from your profile, which now has Overview, Achievements and Skins tabs. Skins: Fancy Suit (all 3 teachers, shop), Field Trip (Wise Sheikh), Fuming (Angry Teacher) and Sporty (Wise Sheikh + Mathematician, 150 💚 in the shop). Equip them from your profile
  • Developer Mode is now a switch inside Test Mode (the separate menu button is gone)

  • The main menu PLAY button now has a hover animation like the Test Mode and Updates buttons: it smoothly lifts up and glows (it had none before because its idle animation was overriding it)

  • New main menu design: a big title, a big glowing ▶ PLAY button, cards for Test Mode, Developer Mode, Online Mode (soon) and Updates, Sign Up / Inbox / Chat / Settings / Tips along the top, and behind it the real green field map with hills and sky, where Wise Sheikh, Angry Teacher and Mathematician fight kebabs live (they use the real game drawings). It follows your theme (Classic, Halloween, Night, Candy) and works on phones
  • New Animated menu background setting (on by default). Turn it off for a still picture; low-effects mode also freezes it

October 17, 2026
  • Performance: Mathematician's Algebra Swarm orbs are now drawn from a pre-made picture instead of being redrawn shape by shape every frame, so late waves with lots of orbs on screen cost less to draw
  • Coin buff: every kebab now pays 15 coins (was 5), a boss kebab pays 60 (was 50) and clearing a wave pays a 20 coin bonus (was 10). Updated everywhere in the guide, tips and Coins page
  • Fixed the intro sometimes not playing or glitching: a double-click on Play or a held key can no longer skip it instantly (skipping works after the first moment), and if anything goes wrong while it plays it now ends cleanly instead of getting stuck
  • Fixed Google sign-in in the desktop app: it now opens your normal web browser to sign in with Google, then sends you back to the game (Firebase can't sign in from inside the app window itself). Opening the game as a plain file now shows a clear message instead of a confusing error

  • Intro tweaks: the cook now stands right next to the grill (no more long reach), the intro fades in from black more slowly (about 1.5 s), and the game fades in longer too. The new Skip intro animation setting replaces the on/off toggle I first added

  • Kebab speed now starts at 1.0 on wave 1 and rises by 0.5 every 5 waves (1.5 from wave 6, 2.0 from wave 11, 2.5 from wave 16) until it maxes at 3.0 from wave 21. Before it rose smoothly by 0.15 every wave and hit 3.0 at wave 15
  • New Kebab Speed counter in the top bar, next to Kebab HP
  • Kebab health now grows a flat +25 HP per wave (100 HP on wave 1) and never speeds up or slows down. Before it started at +30 and shrank every 15 waves
  • New Developer Mode (main menu, next to Test Mode): the normal game with no cheats and no commands, plus a Developer Controls panel for time: game speed (0.25x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x), pause, single-step, and rewind (hold the button or the R key, or jump back 5, 10 or 30 seconds). It saves (see the next line)
  • Developer Mode now saves on this device with no sign-in: it autosaves after every cleared wave and when you press Quit. Next time you open it, choose Continue Battle or New Battle. Losing the game deletes the save
  • Angry Teacher's ability is now called Negative (was Negative Sentrals), and the red mark above marked kebabs now says Negative instead of NS. The guide, tips and shop text were updated to match

  • New Max sounds at once setting (default 8) so lots of teachers attacking together no longer makes a wall of noise, plus a built-in limiter so the sound never clips
  • Angry Teachers no longer use Negative at the same time: each waits her turn (at least 2.5 s apart)

  • Brand new look for the school at the end of the tracks: a bright modern building with a striped awning and glass double doors for each track, a clock, a graduation-cap sign that says SCHOOL, bunting along the roof, a tower of lit windows and a hedge. It follows your theme colours
  • Boss kebabs now pay 50 coins when defeated (normal kebabs still pay 5)
  • NEW: clearing a wave pays a 10 coin bonus. Combined waves (Skip Wave) pay 10 for every wave in the batch. A message shows the bonus when the wave ends
  • Updated the guide, the Coins page, Boss page, Skip Wave, Waves, tutorial and shop tips with the new coin amounts

  • New app icon everywhere - browser tab, PWA install, and the Windows desktop app (Wise Sheikh + "UGDR" logo, design by Jaiden Hernandez)
  • Desktop app updated with the new icon - existing installs will get the "Update Available" prompt automatically
August 30, 2026
  • Angry Teacher's head is bigger, her skin is now a warm orange tone, and her coat has buttons
  • Added accounts: sign up from the menu and your best wave and last online time are saved on this device
  • Accounts now require a password to log in (saved locally on this device only - not real server security)
  • Added a Quit button while playing that asks to save progress if you're signed in, or quits right away if you're not
  • Saving on quit lets you pick up where you left off - clicking Play now offers Continue Battle or New Battle when a save exists
  • Fixed a crash when finishing a wave that stopped Best Wave Survived from ever saving
  • Fixed the account screen sometimes not offering a Log In option when you weren't signed in
  • Kebabs now gain 15 HP per wave instead of 30, so the difficulty ramps up more gently
  • Added Friends: send requests, accept/decline them, and chat from the new Inbox and Chat buttons (only works between accounts on this same device - true cross-device friends will come with Online Mode)
  • Added an Online Mode button to the menu (Coming Soon) - skins are coming soon too
  • Clearing a wave now shows a "Wave Cleared!" message with a countdown to the next split track or shop milestone
  • Added a "What's New" screen to the menu explaining what's different in REMASTERED
  • Added a Tips screen with gameplay tips and illustrations - flip through them with the arrow buttons
  • Moved Account, Inbox, Chat, What's New, and Tips into a single button stack on the right side of the menu, out of the way of Play/Test Mode/Updates/Credits
  • Fixed Angry Teacher's Negative Sentrals mark not actually applying its 3x damage bonus to any attacks
  • Fixed the Tips screen occasionally showing the same tip you just saw last time you opened it
  • Added PWA support - the game can now be installed as an app from a browser once it's hosted online, and will prompt you to update when a new version is deployed
  • Fixed the menu sometimes not responding to the first click(s) after loading - a PWA bug was silently reloading the page right after it opened
  • Added a warning banner if your browser is blocking saved data (common when a game is embedded in another site's player, like itch.io's) - accounts previously failed silently with no explanation in this situation
August 27, 2026
  • Kebab strength (HP) now has no ceiling and keeps climbing every wave, forever
  • Added a live "Kebab HP" readout to the HUD so the scaling is visible in real time
  • Clicking a kebab directly now deals 1 damage to it
  • You can now open and close the Test Mode control panel anytime
  • Added Balanced Mode to Test Mode: caps teachers at 5 and gates tier-2 upgrades behind wave 45, just like the real game
  • Fixed max health display getting stuck (e.g. showing 25/20 instead of 25/25) after buying the Health upgrade
  • Wise Sheikh can now be placed up to 12 times
  • Wise Sheikh's thrown projectiles are now Arabic letters instead of plain dots
  • Wise Sheikh's cost is now capped at 250 and shows the ✨ symbol again
  • Wise Sheikh's ultimate now charges 20% per kebab killed instead of per hit

  • Added main menu with Play, Test Mode, Updates, and Credits
  • Added a Test Mode sandbox for trying out the game freely
  • Teachers standing on the track now take damage from passing kebabs
  • Reworked Angry Teacher's look and buffed her "BOYS!" ultimate range/size
  • Buffed Wise Sheikh's ultimate damage
  • Teacher and upgrade costs now use Positive Sentrals
August 24, 2026
  • Teachers can now be placed right next to and on the track
  • Paths now snap to the checkered grid
  • Added a working ultimate charge bar to all teachers

  • Map doubled in size with left/right navigation arrows
  • Capped kebab health and speed so late waves stay fair
  • Wise Sheikh's ultimate gain reworked around landing hits

⚙️ Settings

Graphics qualityLow turns off shake, hit flash, waddling and teacher animations and trims particles - best for slower computers.
Auto low-effects when laggingSwitches to Low by itself if the game runs slowly for a few seconds.
VSyncOn = drawing is synced to your monitor's refresh rate (smoothest, 60/120/144 FPS and so on). Off = a timer drives the game at the Max FPS below. Browsers can't draw faster than the monitor shows.
Max FPSGameplay speed never changes - this only limits how often the game is drawn. Unlimited = as fast as your monitor goes (about 240 with VSync off).
Field of view (zoom)Smaller = zoom out and see more screen, bigger = zoom in.
100%
ThemeChanges the look of the map and menus.

100%
Max sounds at onceStops loud pile-ups when lots of teachers attack together.
Sound effects
Button & menu soundsA click when you press buttons, and a whooshing wind when menu screens switch.
Shop musicThe shop theme song plays while a shop is open. It follows the Volume slider.
Level-up pop-ups
Screen shake
Animated menu backgroundTeachers fight kebabs on the map behind the main menu. Off = a still picture (saves power).
Event pop-upsPop-ups at the bottom for the next boss, split track, tri-track and shop.
Skip intro animationTurn on to skip the kebab shop cutscene (and the track pop-up) when you press Play.
Teacher animationsBlinking, eye movement and teachers chatting with their neighbours.
Kebab health bars
Show FPS counter
Keep running in the backgroundThe game keeps going when you switch tabs or minimise.
